ModMetaData.name: Faction Lens
ModMetaData.author: CoolNether123
ModMetaData.description:
Relationship-colored names under settlements, sites, and other faction objects on the world map, so you can tell friend from foe at a glance.
- Separate colors for hostile, neutral, allied, your own, abandoned, and unknown - Colorblind preset - Click a name to select that object - Opacity slider and an optional legend - Hover-only mode that keeps the map quiet until you point at something
Adds no save data and changes no diplomacy.
Requires Harmony and SpineLib.
